# `core/memory/ChunkBufferPool.js`

> **Source:** `engine/core/memory/ChunkBufferPool.js`

ChunkBufferPool.js - Object Pool for Chunk Buffers Reduces GC pressure by reusing Uint8Array buffers instead of allocating new ones for each chunk generation. Based on: Vercidium's voxel optimization research Impact: ~10% speed increase from reduced GC pauses

| `getVoxelBuffer` | `getVoxelBuffer()` | Get a voxel buffer (reused or new) |
| `returnVoxelBuffer` | `returnVoxelBuffer(buffer)` | Return a voxel buffer to the pool |

| `getMeshIndexBuffer` | `getMeshIndexBuffer(size)` | Get a mesh index buffer (Uint32Array) |

| `clear` | `clear()` | Clear all pools (for memory pressure situations) |
| `getStats` | `getStats()` | Get pool statistics |
